1.1.q: A customer received her order last week. Which action best reflects the Health & Wealth way?
o: Move on to the next sale; she has already bought.
Check in on how she is doing, answer her questions, and offer support even if it goes beyond products.
Wait until she contacts you.
Contact her only when it is time to reorder.
1.1.w: Not a hit-and-run but a health journey: customers are cared for after the sale.

1.3.q: A customer writes: 'I have arthritis, what should I take?' What is the best first reply?
o: Take SLD, it helps with joints.
Acknowledge warmly, then ask them to describe what is going on in their own words.
Tell them to stop their current tablets and try our products.
Send the full catalogue.
1.3.w: A disease name alone is never enough to recommend anything. Discovery comes first.

The compensation plan includes retail profit and team commissions.
I can show you the official income disclosure.
